search_bound: carrier_count<=2; all three Boolean endpoint/link flags
lower_bound_argument: One carrier cannot instantiate a distinct source/target pair; two carriers suffice.

search_bound: carrier_count<=2; stage_count<=3; one copy edge; one possible mixed stage; all endpoint flags
lower_bound_argument: Distinct transport needs two carriers; source derivation needs one copy edge; a detached model has zero mixed stages.

search_bound: all ordered permutation pairs on 1..3 states
lower_bound_argument: Permutation groups on one and two points are abelian; three points are the first possible noncommuting case.

search_bound: all deterministic supported/withdrawn transition tables on 1..3 states
lower_bound_argument: One state cannot exhibit nontrivial progress; two states suffice for supported motion and withdrawn stasis.

search_bound: all transition tables on <=2 states and <=2 phases
lower_bound_argument: A one-state, one-phase self-loop is the smallest stable system and already lacks progress.

search_bound: all current-observation and binary continuation-output maps on <=3 hidden states and <=2 public symbols
lower_bound_argument: At least two hidden states are required for a collision with different futures; one current symbol suffices.

search_bound: one or two nodes; cyclic clocks of modulus 1..4; all loop translations
lower_bound_argument: Modulus one has no nonzero translation; one node with a modulus-two loop is the smallest obstruction.

search_bound: 1..3 clauses, 1..2 coordinates, 1..2 values, all shared-coordinate assignments
lower_bound_argument: One clause always glues; two clauses and two values are the first possible overlap disagreement.

search_bound: all observation maps and hidden Boolean facts on <=3 states and <=2 public symbols
lower_bound_argument: Two internal states are necessary for a collision with opposite hidden facts; one public symbol suffices.

search_bound: all binary defect vectors of length 1..10
lower_bound_argument: At a fixed one-tenth threshold, one failed binary gate needs at least ten components: 1/n <= 1/10 first holds at n=10.
A fixed-point-free symmetry needs at least two targets; the two-cycle is minimal.

search_bound: all temporal-realization bit traces of length 1..4
lower_bound_argument: A source endpoint, an internal gap, and a target endpoint require at least three stages.
A one-transition live prefix followed by failure requires budgets 2->1->0, hence three states.

search_bound: one or two carriers; one to three representations; all representation permutations
lower_bound_argument: A nonidentity re-encoding needs two representations, while the negative control fixes one carrier.

search_bound: all pairs of binary relations over alphabets of size 1..2
lower_bound_argument: A one-symbol alphabet or singleton support is determined by its marginals; two binary support points are minimal.
